idleRecipe: async page => { const intervals=await page.evaluate(()=>new Promise(resolve=>{const intervals=[]; let previous; const start=performance.now(); function sample(now){if(previous!==undefined) intervals.push(now-previous); previous=now; if(now-start>=30000) resolve(intervals);else requestAnimationFrame(sample);}requestAnimationFrame(sample);})); const sorted=[...intervals].sort((a,b)=>a-b); return {intervals,count:intervals.length,p95:sorted[Math.ceil(sorted.length*.95)-1],p99:sorted[Math.ceil(sorted.length*.99)-1],max:sorted.at(-1)}; }
activeRecipe: async page => { const cdp=await page.context().newCDPSession(page); await cdp.send('Runtime.enable'); const markers=[]; cdp.on('Runtime.consoleAPICalled',e=>{const value=e.args?.[0]?.value;if(typeof value==='string' && (value.startsWith('CCRUN ')||value.startsWith('CCRESULT ')))markers.push({timestamp:e.timestamp,text:value});});await page.mouse.move(688,836);await page.waitForTimeout(150);await page.mouse.click(688,836);const pacing=await page.evaluate(()=>new Promise(resolve=>{const intervals=[];let previous;const start=performance.now();function sample(now){if(previous!==undefined)intervals.push(now-previous);previous=now;if(now-start>=30000)resolve({intervals,start,end:now,timeOrigin:performance.timeOrigin});else requestAnimationFrame(sample);}requestAnimationFrame(sample);}));await page.waitForTimeout(500);await cdp.detach();const sorted=[...pacing.intervals].sort((a,b)=>a-b);return {...pacing,markers,count:sorted.length,p95:sorted[Math.ceil(sorted.length*.95)-1],p99:sorted[Math.ceil(sorted.length*.99)-1],max:sorted.at(-1)}; }
